inputs.name: Static RAM root with console and Wi-Fi tools

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, boot the ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI kernel in normal multiuser RAM mode and attempt the selected WPA3/SAE profile with PMF required.
expected: The selected BSS passes vendor compatibility checks, SAE completes, association uses PMF, and the interface obtains an IP address for data exchange.
observed: One continuous first-cycle capture recorded candidate, DEBUG-begin, warning-restore and terminal markers once each; the vendor DEBUG-enable and warning-restore calls returned 0. The earlier empty-password rejection and reason 210 were absent. Vendor auth mode was WIFI_AUTH_WPA3_PSK (6), PMF capable/required were 1/1, and PWE configuration input was 0. The kernel queued AUTH generation 1. The vendor wpa_sta_connect callback returned 0; SAE commit build (type 1, 98 bytes) and parse (status 126) returned 0, followed by SAE confirm build (type 2, 34 bytes) and parse (status 0), both returning 0. The vendor received an association response (type 0x10) and transitioned init -> auth -> assoc -> run. At 19.882 s after kernel boot, EmberBSD entered join-worker teardown generation 2 and called disconnect; the vendor then transitioned run -> init, sent disassoc(8), and emitted disconnect reason 8, which the kernel recorded. No received deauth/disassoc or AUTH/association timeout appeared before teardown. A later read-only supplicant status reported SCANNING; WPA_COMPLETED and negotiated key-management/PMF were not observed. DHCP/DNS and data exchange were not verified.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The RAM root is identified by role only; its private configuration is not part of this shared record.
Elapsed time is from bootm to the terminal diagnostic marker. The private capture and its path are not part of this shared record.
SAE commit/confirm and association response were observed, but WPA_COMPLETED and negotiated PMF were not; DHCP/DNS and data exchange remain unverified.
The capture shows a local disconnect and reason 8 but does not identify what queued teardown generation 2.
WPA2-only authentication, reconnect, roaming and sustained transfer remain unaccepted.
